email.subject: Summit freight elevator trim damage
email.body:
Accounting,

We've got an estimated $890 in repairs to the freight elevator trim at Summit after material deliveries. I know it was one of the Ridgeline crews, but I can't tell if it was Drywall or Glass & Glazing.

Can someone check the delivery logs with the superintendent before assigning this back-charge? Please don't pick a Ridgeline account yet.

Thanks,
Dana
